title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Goal
moral: Believing in yourself helps you do things you never thought you could.

pages.content: {{NAME}} stood at the edge of a big green field. The soccer goal looked very far away. All the other children were kicking the ball so well. {{NAME}} was afraid to try. He sat down in the tall grass at the side.

pages.content: A little fairy landed on {{NAME}}'s knee. She had wings like flower petals. She wore a tiny soccer kit just like his. Her name was Flo. "Why are you sitting here?" she asked. {{NAME}}'s eyes went wide.

pages.content: Flo flew around the ball and sprinkled golden dust on it. "Now kick it!" she called. {{NAME}} ran up fast and gave a big kick. The ball flew through the air. It zoomed right into the goal with a loud swish!
